name: HoaViolationTracker
tagline: Covenant enforcement from courtesy notice to board hearing – in one Power Apps control
description: Complete HOA and condominium violation tracking app for Power Apps and Power Pages: notice ladder with cure periods, due-process hearing notice, fine schedule with repeat multiplier and cap, generated notice letters, payments and waivers, board, calendar and repeat-property views.
features: Courtesy, first and second notices with cure periods per severity
Hearing scheduling with minimum written notice
Fines only after a held hearing, repeat multiplier and cap
Repeat violations per property within a configurable window
Drag-and-drop notice ladder with rule checks
Bulk next notice, assign, mark cured, export, delete
Undo, validation, read-only, empty, loading and map-your-columns states
Phone layout with bottom bar, cards and agenda
Power Fx outputs and OnSave / OnCreate / OnStatusChange events
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
